message: No detected input validation: The code applies basic regex parsing and range-based DELETE statements (e.g., cost < 8000, area > 2000) but performs no explicit schema checks, dtype assertions, or structured value-range guards on the incoming scraped data before processing.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched via Scrapy spiders using os.system calls with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks on the remote sources being scraped.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no comparison of label distributions, validation against expected label sets, or use of any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The range-based deletions (e.g., cost < 8000, area > 2000, ceiling_height > 5) are simple hard-coded threshold filters for obviously erroneous values, not statistical anomaly detection or outlier-based poisoning defenses; no systematic statistical checks or outlier detection methods are applied.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models via `train_all_models` but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading any pretrained weights or serialized models anywhere in the visible code.

No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training; data cleaning only removes outliers by hard-coded thresholds.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library or mechanism (e.g., Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used in any part of the training pipeline.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are present anywhere in the code; evaluation is limited to correlation and distribution plots.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics; the code only generates exploratory visualizations from the full dataset.

No detected input sanitization: The code performs data cleaning and regex-based parsing during preparation stages, but there is no inference endpoint visible, and no input validation or schema checks are applied to incoming inference requests.
No detected output bounds checks: No inference serving code is present in the snippet; model outputs are never checked for NaN, probability bounds, or calibration thresholds.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses a numeric regression/classification model for apartment pricing, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
